commands.command:
set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /usr/local/libexec
cat > /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import json
import os
import socket
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = {
    "service": "inventory-api",
    "node": socket.gethostname(),
    "items": [
        {"sku": "widget-blue", "quantity": 42},
        {"sku": "widget-green", "quantity": 17},
    ],
}

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            body = json.dumps({"status": "ok", "service": "inventory-api"}).encode()
            status = 200
        elif self.path in ("/", "/inventory"):
            body = json.dumps(INVENTORY).encode()
            status = 200
        else:
            body = json.dumps({"error": "not found"}).encode()
            status = 404
        self.send_response(status)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)
    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        print("%s - %s" % (self.address_string(), fmt % args), flush=True)

port = int(os.environ.get("INVENTORY_API_PORT", "8080"))
ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", port), Handler).serve_forever()
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api
restorecon -v /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api 2>/dev/null || true
/usr/bin/python3 -m py_compile /usr/local/libexec/inventory-api

commands.command:
set -eu
cat > /tmp/memory-hog-test.py <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
#!/usr/bin/python3
import os
import time

with open("/proc/self/oom_score_adj", "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
    f.write("1000")
print("memory-hog pid=%d oom_score_adj=%s" % (
    os.getpid(), open("/proc/self/oom_score_adj", encoding="ascii").read().strip()
), flush=True)
chunks = []
allocated = 0
while True:
    block = bytearray(32 * 1024 * 1024)
    for offset in range(0, len(block), 4096):
        block[offset] = 0xA5
    chunks.append(block)
    allocated += len(block)
    print("allocated_mib=%d" % (allocated // 1024 // 1024), flush=True)
    time.sleep(0.02)
ANTRIEB_EOF
chmod 0755 /tmp/memory-hog-test.py
/usr/bin/python3 -m py_compile /tmp/memory-hog-test.py

#!/bin/sh
i=0
while [ "$i" -lt 900 ]; do
  now=$(date +%s.%N)
  api_pid=$(systemctl show -p MainPID --value inventory-api.service 2>/dev/null)
  if body=$(curl --fail --silent --max-time 1 "http://$NODE_IP:8080/health"); then
    printf '%s ok pid=%s body=%s\n' "$now" "$api_pid" "$body"
  else
    printf '%s FAIL pid=%s\n' "$now" "$api_pid"
  fi
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 0.2
done
ANTRIEB_EOF
